name: Dynamic UNPIVOT of Wide Tabular Sensor / Survey Metrics
description: Legacy data or spreadsheet exports often arrive with metric names as column headers (cpu, memory, disk). Normalizing them into key-value pairs is necessary for time-series modeling.
prompt:
Legacy data or spreadsheet exports often arrive with metric names as column headers (cpu, memory, disk). Normalizing them into key-value pairs is necessary for time-series modeling.

Execute the required analytical SQL calculation in DuckDB.
Expected output columns: host_id, captured_date, metric_name, metric_value.
Row order does not matter.
golden_sql:
-- Transform wide metric columns into normalized key-value rows
            UNPIVOT wide_telemetry
            ON cpu_metric, mem_metric, disk_metric
            INTO
                NAME metric_name
                VALUE metric_value;
why_it_fails: Chaining 10 UNION ALL queries multiplies read passes over the source data.
